name: Mango Banana Smoothie
steps: Cube the mango flesh and slice peeled banana; chill both so the blended fruit stays thick.
Blend mango, banana, yogurt and half the milk until completely smooth.
Add remaining milk, lime juice and honey; taste, then pulse with ice just until frothy.
Pour into four glasses and serve promptly; stir once if it stands for a few minutes.
tips: The banana already sweetens the drink, so add honey only after tasting.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
